# Summarize CLI

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a working CLI skill for the `summarize` binary (summarize.sh): summarize any URL, local file, PDF, or YouTube link in one command, with best-effort YouTube transcript extraction built in — no `yt-dlp` needed. Supports short-to-XXL lengths, `--extract` to print raw content without the LLM pass, `--json` machine output, Firecrawl fallback for blocked sites, and an Apify fallback for YouTube. Requires an API key from your chosen provider — OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, or Google (aliases supported) — set as an environment variable, never pasted in chat; a paid service. Honest notes: transcription is best-effort (URLs only, and huge transcripts get a tight summary first with an offer to expand), and the binary installs via the project's own tap. By @openclaw, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
